reports.scope: CPU FP32 tiny random full-attention Qwen2. Controlled first rejection, middle rejection and all-accepted drafts produce the same ten outputs as an independent Engine greedy reference; all twelve reserved slots are returned. Separate oracle preparation, target input work, accepted/proposed counts, correction, bonus and direct target tokens are recorded. Seven related source hashes.
reports.limits: Candidates come from a precomputed greedy answer and intentionally modified IDs, not a trained draft. No timing, real checkpoint, NPU execution, MTP or DSpark. Hybrid-state rollback is unsupported. Full-logit cold-reference and poisoned-storage checks are CPU unit tests, not included as numeric measurements in this demo report.
